# Review

## Outcome

**Approved**

## Evidence

- Full tank_core package test suite: all 43 test binaries pass with zero failures, zero ignored (except 1 doc-test). Total ~500+ tests across unit and integration suites.
- 24 substrate unit tests pass, including all acceptance-criteria tests: rooted_plants_increase_o2_penetration, root_oxygenation_proportional_to_biomass_with_diminishing_returns, floating_plant_biomass_does_not_increase_penetration, zero_root_biomass_yields_zero_oxygenation_bonus, root_oxygenation_uses_named_parameter, root_oxygenation_dynamic_tracks_biomass_growth_and_decline, root_oxygenation_requires_rootable_substrate_habitats, zero_rol_rate_removes_rooted_oxygenation_effects, fully_oxic_bed_reports_zero_root_oxygenation_bonus.
- 5 root_zone_oxygenation integration tests pass: planted_vs_unplanted_diverge_in_penetration_depth (500h), planted_substrate_denitrification_interaction (500h), root_oxygenation_reduces_hourly_denitrification_when_it_shrinks_suboxic_volume, planted_substrate_nitrification_surface_area (500h with nitrifier/nitrate divergence), tracing_exposes_root_oxygenation.
- 12 denitrification tests pass with zero failures.
- 6 habitat geometry probe tests pass (5 individual probes #[ignore]d, 1 summary runner executes all 5 probes once). No double-execution in default CI runs.
- cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings: clean. cargo clippy -p tank_harness -- -D warnings: clean. cargo fmt --all --check: clean.
- ROL formula verified correct (substrate.rs:99-115): remaining_depth = (total_depth - base_penetration).max(0); bonus = remaining_depth × (1 - exp(-(active_root_biomass × rol_rate) / remaining_depth)). Saturating exponential bounded by remaining available depth, not full bed depth. Zero bonus when bed is already fully oxic (remaining_depth ≤ EPSILON).
- Regression test fully_oxic_bed_reports_zero_root_oxygenation_bonus (substrate.rs:1236) confirms zero bonus and correct effective_penetration when base already spans the full bed.
- Only PlantGuild::RootFeedingRosette contributes to active root biomass (substrate.rs:149 filter). Floating/epiphytic/fast-stem guilds excluded.
- rol_rate_cm_per_g is a named parameter in ProcessParams (process.rs:176-189) with serde default 0.15 cm/g, invariant-checked non-negative (invariants.rs:276), and present in default.toml (line 104). Not hardcoded.
- step_substrate_zones returns SubstrateOxygenationBreakdown (substrate.rs:51-76) and engine.rs:410 reuses the returned value for four budget metrics and four stage notes — no redundant recomputation at the engine level.
- Tracing output: structured tracing::debug! at substrate.rs:59-69 exposes base_penetration_cm, root_oxygenation_bonus_cm, active_root_biomass_g, effective_penetration_cm as separate named fields. Integration test tracing_exposes_root_oxygenation validates presence.
- Habitat-geometry probe deduplication: all 5 individual probe tests marked #[ignore = 'run explicitly with -- --ignored when iterating on a single habitat probe']. File-level doc comment at lines 20-23 explains the pattern. Default cargo test runs only all_habitat_geometry_probes_summary.

## Findings and Gaps

- Minor: from_parts (engine.rs:132) discards the SubstrateOxygenationBreakdown returned by step_substrate_zones during initialization. Harmless since init-time tracing isn't needed, but a minor API inconsistency. Non-blocking.
- Minor: root_oxygenation_active_biomass_g() (substrate.rs:139) internally calls compute_habitat_registry() on each invocation. Since substrate_oxygenation_breakdown() calls this function, there is a redundant registry computation within the substrate module itself. The engine-level double-computation was fixed, but this intra-module redundancy remains. Non-blocking — the computation is cheap and correctness is unaffected.
- The effective_penetration_cm computation (substrate.rs:116) no longer clamps to total_depth_cm. This is safe because remaining_depth_cm is already clamped to [0, total_depth - base] and the exponential saturation bounds the bonus within remaining_depth, so the sum base + bonus cannot exceed total_depth. The math is correct but the removed clamp was an extra safety net. Non-blocking.

## Follow-up and Amendments

- No blocking amendments required. All acceptance criteria are satisfied with passing tests, clean clippy, and clean formatting across both tank_core and tank_harness packages. The two final-review amendments from this cycle (ROL bonus remaining-depth saturation, probe test deduplication) have been properly implemented and verified.
